name: custompage-update
description: A custom page update skill based on the Tradebee Website Builder Open API. It is used to update one existing custom page under a specified site language. Before sending the update request, it automatically reads the current record and writes a local JSON backup file for restore use.

language.description: Required. Exact site language code to update in, such as `en` or `fr`. Do not guess or translate it.

custompage.description: Required. Update payload for one existing custom page. `custompage_id` is required and every other field is optional: omit any field that should stay unchanged.

custompage_id.description: Required. Existing custom page ID to update. Do not invent it. Read or obtain the real custompage_id first, then copy that exact integer here.

title.description: Optional. Custom page title, up to 100 characters. Omit it if the title should stay unchanged.

content.description:
Optional. HTML fragment only. Do not include any `

` tag, and prefer `

` to `

`. `` may use a normal URL or `data:image/...;base64,...`. At most 50 `` tags are allowed. Each single `` image must be 500 kB or smaller. The 100,000-character limit is checked after removing `` tags. Before generating this field, call `rule-get` with the exact selected `language` and the exact scene value `custompage.content`. Do not guess, translate, normalize, shorten, or rename either `language` or `scene`. The fragment must follow the full rule payload returned by `rule-get`, including the current tenant structure rules such as starting with one root `
` element and placing one embedded `

seo.description: Optional. SEO fields for the custom page detail page. Omit the whole `seo` object if SEO should stay unchanged.

keywords.description: SEO keywords as one comma-separated string, with up to 6 keywords and total length 120 characters or fewer.

confirmation.description: Required. Proof that the user explicitly approved this exact custom page update request after seeing the final language, target custom page ID, payload, and automatic local backup behavior.

approved.description: Must be `true` only after the user explicitly confirms the language, target custom page ID, and exact custom page payload to be changed.

summary.description: Required confirmation note that restates the language, target custom page ID, and exact payload shown to the user before execution.

status.description: Request status. `true` indicates success and `false` indicates failure.

url.description: Preview URL for the updated custom page. Always return this to the user and ask the user to preview it.

backup.description: Returned when the automatic pre-update backup succeeds. It includes backup file storage metadata, the raw read API response, the extracted pre-change snapshot, and a best-effort `restore_payload` that can be passed back into `custompage-update` to restore the previous state.
